'''Maulkiller's lightsabers''' were [[Lightsaber/Legends|two lightsabers]] owned by the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Maulkiller]]. They were used by Maulkiller to [[Death/Legends|kill]] and cause destruction.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />

{{Top|leg}}

==Behind the scenes==
The "Maulkiller Silver Saber Crystal", simply known as "Amplification" in-game, was a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GameStop GameStop] exclusive pre-order bonus for the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /><ref name="GameStop" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|First appearance) <small>(GameStop exclusive preorder bonus for [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions}}</small>
